rationale: Each component maps to an explicit requirement in the task spec. claim_volume by claim_status with the figure gives total volume, the status mix and claims_status_distribution.png. denial_rate uses the adjudicated_claims denominator because the spec restricts the rate to claims whose adjudication has concluded and excludes pending claims; the default all_claims would understate the rate and contradict the spec. fraud_prevalence is not selected by default, so it is added explicitly with the all_claims denominator because the spec asks for prevalence across the whole portfolio (the 647 non-null fraud_pattern_type rows suggest roughly 5% prevalence, so the numerator/denominator statement matters). financial_summary covers billed, allowed and paid with sum_mean_quantiles to supply totals, means and distribution quantiles. monthly_trend is keyed on service_date_from (month in which service began) rather than the default adjudication_date, with claim_count as the volume series; the component records unparseable_dates as the spec requires. write_report includes the synthetic_data and descriptive_only caveats the spec mandates, prints every rate as numerator / denominator, and cites artifacts so every number traces to a saved file. No skills were provided in this condition, so skills_applied is empty.
